known_caveats: Positive invasive-plant cover at an AIM plot supports historical recorded presence at that sampled BLM location only. Missing, zero-cover, unmatched, and rejected rows are source silence and never support county absence or survey non-detection.
source_warnings: BLM AIM plot detections support recorded presence only on sampled BLM lands.
Source silence, zero cover, and rejected records never support absence or non-detection.
